content: Root cause: The bug occurred due to a failure in the coordinator action to transition out of the "WAITING" state when there were no dataset dependencies defined in the coordinator job XML. The implementation did not correctly handle cases where the list of missing dependencies was empty, causing the action to remain stuck in "WAITING." The patch addressed this by introducing a condition that allows an action to become "READY" if there are no missing dependencies, along with the addition of a new test case to verify this functionality.
